title: Derived extension-by-zero and restriction adjunction
statement: Let (X, O_X) be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let j:U \to X be an open inclusion, and let j_! be the exact extension-by-zero functor left adjoint to restriction on sheaves of O-modules [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. Applying these exact functors termwise to complexes gives functors on the derived categories D(O_U) and D(O_X) of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every A in D(O_U) and B in D(O_X) there is a natural bijection Hom_{D(O_X)}(j_! A, B) = Hom_{D(O_U)}(A, B restricted to U).

source.place: Tag 08BW proof, using Tags 08BS and 08BT (derived extension-by-zero/restriction adjunction)

proof.text: Take G = extensionByZeroPresheaf followed by sheafification and F = overFunctor. The adjunction G ⊣ F and exactness of G are supplied by [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]; F is already additive and exact. Obtain G.Additive from Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] to get G.mapHomotopyCategory ⊣ F.mapHomotopyCategory.

Use the homotopy-category factorization isomorphisms Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh from [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Their inverses define CatCommSq instances for the two exact functors and DerivedCategory.Qh. The latter are localizations at HomotopyCategory.quasiIso by [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Applying Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.localization to the termwise adjunction and these two squares gives G.mapDerivedCategory ⊣ F.mapDerivedCategory. Wrap this adjunction in Nonempty. The additive and exactness instances are the proof terms specified in the unchanged statement, by proof irrelevance.
